name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) hard matches 'make your very next move the one that picks it back up', since holding_box can only return on the step after a fall through that pickup. Response(at_exit, holding_box) hard matches 'if you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands'. Both sentences are conditionals, so no Existence is owed for reaching the exit, and the rule-only warning with empty FINAL_STATES is valid.

texts: If the box falls, the very next step must be the pickup that puts it back in hand, so holding_box is true on the step right after box_fell.
If the agent stands on the exit cell, it must be holding the box on that step.
